candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Me Jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border opposite Joppa.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and took it, and struck it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and lived therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.
